GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then tightened & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and then tightened shortly after the start. Raced three-wide without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 1 length 3 Wide , held together much same to turn 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , hit Lead 250m, all but joined at 120m, raced head'n'head to the line # wide/battled well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward on-pace oppo Settled Down 2nd Inside 2 Lengths Fast Pace on, Under Pressure x 400m Held Ground to line, not run to suit - # stuck to chase
Jumped Ok , overraced Worse than midfield Two Wide 5 Lengths 600m, weakened in Straight # overraced/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out abruptly at the start. Near the 800m shifted out and away from runners. Steadied out across the heels near the 500m when in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide joint Lead settling down, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing a long neck, drifted out rounding turn, 3-4 Wide Straightening Up then Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at start. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide joint Lead sttling down, trailed two-thirds of a length Two Wide turning, kept trying but couldn't go with the winner down the Straight # winner far too good

Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn then Hooked Out Wide Straightening Up , trailed more than 2 Lengths once it got balanced and started to chase, Made Some Ground to the line. Looks to want 1000m with a class drop. # battled on fairly

Slow Out 0.9 Lengths pushed on Four Wide before easing 4-5 Lengths (700m), cornered last & way too far back, no run on (rider dropped whip 150/suffered laceration to right hind pastern) # complete forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Rdr dropped whip near the 150m. A post-race vet exam revealed a laceration to its right hind pastern. Vet clearance prior to resuming.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down Narrow Lead Inside led 1 Lengths Straightening Up flat @ 200m, Collared x 50m, # found wanting late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount was inclined to lay out in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok rails gate Quickly went Through to hold the fence a marginal second (700m), railed Through to level up Straight , headed 200 not done with, rallied hard & did too well (Nasal Strip FIRST TIME) # wouldn't lie down

Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field Two Wide 4 Lengths 700m, Ridden Along in tight room Straightening Up , did cop a squeeze at 200m and had to steady, faded from then on and should have finished closer # squeezed 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure down the running crowding another runner near the 200m before being bumped and shifting in further and bumping another runner again before being crowded and having to be steadied itself.
